hooks.name: QA Automation Guard
hooks.description: All-in-one QA automation hook that enforces conventions, validates spec structure, verifies fixture registration, runs tests, generates reports, and summarizes coverage — all in a single hook.

action.prompt:
You are the QA Automation Guard. Apply the following checks based on what just happened:

FOR SPEC FILES (.spec.js):
- Verify imports { test, expect } from src/fixtures/pageFixtures.js (not @playwright/test)
- Verify test.use({ storageState: { cookies: [], origins: [] } }) is present if fresh auth needed
- Verify TC_ID naming format in test titles (TC_MODULE_NNN)
- Verify no hard-coded credentials or URLs
- Verify import paths have correct ../ levels for file location
- Verify no test.only is present
- Run the test: npx playwright test "<file-path>" --project=chromium
- If it fails, identify root cause and fix it

FOR PAGE OBJECTS (src/pages/*.js):
- Verify the class extends BasePage
- Verify it's registered as a fixture in src/fixtures/pageFixtures.js
- Verify it's exported from src/pages/index.js
- Verify locators exist in src/locators/ with both angular and react variants
- Verify no raw selectors are hardcoded — must use locator files

FOR ANY WRITE OPERATION:
- No hard-coded credentials
- No test.only
- No raw selectors in test files
- ES Module syntax (import/export, never require)

AFTER TASK COMPLETION:
- Generate Allure report: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
- Provide QA coverage summary: what was covered (positive/negative/boundary), gaps, cross-framework status, suggested follow-ups
